title: exudyn.cMath: the portable math functions of Exudyn for floats and numpy arrays
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG11.10.3: sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, atan2, exp, log, pow, sinh, cosh, tanh, cbrt (EM, #2953) and sqrt, for a float or a numpy array (loop in C++); test: the same bits as experimental.EvaluateMathFunction(implementation='exudyn'); timing against math and numpy.
releaseNotes: exudyn.cMath: sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, atan2, exp, log, pow, sinh, cosh, tanh, cbrt and sqrt of the C++ code, the same bits on every platform, for a float or a numpy array; and pi (revision2026c step RG11.10.3)
